title: evidence-de (v2.9)
description: Delivery Evidence. Issued by RDP(in) upon recipient acceptance (or quorum satisfaction for role addressing).

event.description: ETSI EN 319 522-1 clause 6 event (component G03), selected by the delivery grade (the I-D (Message Flows and Delivery States); spec §8.3b): E.1 ContentHandover (default) or D.6 ContentAccessTracking for the verification grade (S4 == S3 under any-one); C.3 ConsignmentAcceptance for the acceptance grade (S4 under quorum/all); D.1 ContentConsignment ONLY at the declared availability grade (authenticated S2, the TS clause 6) — at every other grade D.1 is a non-operative EP.states[] record, never a DE event. See Annex I.

acceptance_policy_kind.description: Kind of the BW-ORG-v1 acceptance policy that was satisfied (the I-D (Evidence Objects and COSE Packaging), §8.3). Recorded so the quorum-required constraint is schema-checkable. When 'quorum', the quorum array is REQUIRED.

quorum.description: Present (and non-empty) when acceptance_policy_kind is 'quorum'; lists the members that acknowledged the message. X-05 (evidence 2.3): each entry states HOW its act is attested — 'wallet-signed' is an independently portable per-member proof (the same construction as the s3 signed arm, resolved per (mid, device_id) against the roster and verified against the published confirmation_key anchor); 'provider' is an RDP assertion and EXPLICITLY NARROWS the DE's acceptance claim for that member (the entry itself says so). The pre-2.3 bare {mid, ack_at} shape is rejected. TODO(legal): the Article 43(2) weight of a provider-attested quorum member awaits counsel.

delivery_grade.description: The delivery grade in force for the message's content class (spec §8.3b, v1.10): which act made delivery legally operative. availability is valid only where the recipient's signed BW-ORG (frozen by acceptance_policy_ref) explicitly declares it for the content class — never implicit (LINT-BND-11).

integrity_basis.description: What the payload_hash in this DE rests on (v2.3). recipient-verified-digest: an authorised recipient re-computed and matched the digest (s3_attestation present; verification/acceptance grades). sender-declared-digest: availability grade — the DE attests availability of the sealed content to an authenticated endpoint and the sender-declared digest only; there is no recipient confirmation (the TS clause 6).

grade_commitment.description: Salted grade commitment (v1.15, the I-D (Grade Commitment)): REQUIRED at the availability grade, absent at every other grade. SHA-256 over the deterministic-CBOR fixed-position array [dst=sm-mls:grade-commitment:v2, salt, content_class, grade, org_digest]; the salt travels only in the E2EE envelope; verification via the TS clause 6 reveal procedure (LINT-DE-11, LINT-BND-11).

envelope_hash.description: F-02 (evidence 2.2): REQUIRED at the availability grade — the one grade with no recipient confirmation now binds the exact TLS-serialized MLSMessage octets made available to the authenticated endpoint; within an EP it MUST equal the SE's (LINT-DE-17). At the confirmed grades the commitment lives in s3_attestation.envelope_hash (LINT-DE-16).

allOf.$comment: V5/LINT-DE-05: acceptance under a quorum or all policy is an acceptance event (EN 319 522-1 C.3), not a handover (E.1) or access-tracking (D.6). Annex I.1.
